folder_purpose: OKF Model Reference & 66degrees Case Study Content Writing Guidelines

brand_identity.core_value_proposition: Premier Google Cloud Partner delivering end-to-end cloud transformation, data engineering, modern analytics, and generative AI solutions.
brand_identity.brand_voice: Results-driven, authoritative, client-focused, technical yet accessible, and impact-oriented.

target_audience: Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) & Chief Information Officers (CIOs)
VPs and Directors of Cloud, Data, and Software Engineering
Enterprise IT Decision Makers & Cloud Architects
Google Cloud Partner Managers & Enterprise Sales Teams

title_and_headline.formatting_rules: Highlight the client, the Google Cloud solution implemented, and the primary quantifiable outcome.
examples: How 66degrees Accelerated Data Modernization for Retail Giant with Google BigQuery
Scaling Enterprise Generative AI on Vertex AI: A 66degrees Success Story

components: Client Overview: Brief description of the client and industry.
The Challenge: 1-2 sentence core problem statement.
The Solution: Core Google Cloud technologies & 66degrees services leveraged.
Key Results & Metrics: 3-4 bulleted quantitative impact metrics (e.g., 40% cost reduction, 3x faster query performance).

content_rules: Describe the legacy system limitations, pain points, or scaling bottlenecks.
Highlight the business risk or opportunity lost if not addressed.
Explain why previous solutions fell short and why Google Cloud was chosen.

the_66degrees_solution.formatting: Structured narrative with subheadings, technical details, and architectural descriptions.
content_rules: Detail 66degrees' strategic approach, discovery phase, and execution roadmap.
Highlight specific Google Cloud products (e.g., BigQuery, Vertex AI, Looker, GKE, Dataflow).
Emphasize 66degrees' proprietary methodologies, cloud expertise, and change management.

impact_and_measurable_results.formatting: Callout stat boxes and narrative detailing business outcomes.

client_quote_and_testimonial.required_fields: Client Executive Name, Title, Company Name, and explicit endorsement of 66degrees' partnership.

writing_and_style_standards.formatting: Use short paragraphs, bold key metrics, bullet points, and visual architecture callouts.
writing_and_style_standards.seo_and_linking: Include internal links to relevant service pages, Google Cloud product pages, and related 66degrees blog posts.

dos: Focus on tangible, verified metrics and real business outcomes.
Position 66degrees as a strategic, trusted co-innovator alongside Google Cloud.
Use clear, professional, and precise technical language.
donts: Don't make vague claims without supporting data or statistics.
Don't overcomplicate with unneeded jargon that obscures the business value.
Don't omit the client's original pain points or business context.
